shared_elements: vertically stacked composition (head above, body below)
incised linear detail on a headdress/head area
carved eyes and mouth rendered as simple oval cavities
suggestion of arms/hands over a torso
circular/oval element on the chest region
justification: Both are tall, frontally oriented stone figures organised as a vertical stack — an elaborated head or headdress at the top with incised linear markings, a face beneath, and a torso with arms and a rounded central element on the chest — which is a genuine compositional correspondence. The rendering, however, is quite different: A is a broad, flat slab covered in shallow, fine incised low relief on dark stone, while B is a narrow, boldly modelled three-dimensional column in pale stone with deeply cut, almost caricatural features such as the bared teeth, which have no counterpart in A.
